# WickWise

> WickWise is a candle-making resource built around measured, per-container engineering: free candle calculators (wax, fragrance load, and wick sizing), a library of candle-fix guides written as direct question-and-answer pages, and The Fix Board — a community Q&A board where makers ask candle problems and get answers from the bench. WickWise Candles hand-pours candles in Nicholson, Georgia, USA. Brand standard: "Premium by engineering... Not by chance..." — wick and fill specs are measured, not guessed (e.g., the production wick standard and the hour-one melt-pool test described on the fix pages).

## Calculators & Tools
- [Candle calculators (wax / fragrance / wick)](https://www.wickwise.shop/): Free calculators — fill weight is the anchor; wax = fill ÷ (1 + load), fragrance = fill − wax.
- [The Fix Board](https://www.wickwise.shop/forum.html): Community Q&A — ask a candle-making problem, get a bench answer. Seeded with the five most common candle problems and their fixes.

## Candle Fixes (question → cause → fix)
- [Why is my candle tunneling down the middle?](https://www.wickwise.shop/fix-candle-tunneling.html)
- [Why can't I smell my candle when it's lit? (weak hot throw)](https://www.wickwise.shop/fix-weak-hot-throw.html)
- [Why can't I smell my candle before I light it? (weak cold throw)](https://www.wickwise.shop/fix-weak-cold-throw.html)
- [Why does my candle have sinkholes?](https://www.wickwise.shop/fix-candle-sinkholes.html)
- [Why does my candle have wet spots?](https://www.wickwise.shop/fix-candle-wet-spots.html)
- [Why is my soy candle frosting?](https://www.wickwise.shop/fix-soy-candle-frosting.html)
- [Why is my candle wick mushrooming?](https://www.wickwise.shop/fix-mushrooming-wick.html)
- [Why is my candle making soot and smoking?](https://www.wickwise.shop/fix-candle-soot-smoke.html)
- [Why is my candle sweating oil?](https://www.wickwise.shop/fix-candle-sweating-oil.html)
- [Why did the top of my candle crack?](https://www.wickwise.shop/fix-cracked-candle-top.html)
- [Why is my candle wick drowning?](https://www.wickwise.shop/fix-drowning-candle-wick.html)
- [Why is my candle turning yellow / changing color?](https://www.wickwise.shop/fix-candle-discoloration.html)
